Check Title: External GitHub Actions use full commit SHAs
Threat Scenarios: SUPPLY-CHAIN-MUTABLE-ACTION: A mutable Action or reusable workflow reference is moved or compromised and executes code that was not reviewed.; SUPPLY-CHAIN-VULNERABLE-ACTION: A full-SHA-pinned Action release remains immutable but is affected by a subsequently published reviewed security advisory.
Threat Actor or Source: compromised Action maintainer or attacker moving a mutable upstream ref

Threat Actor or Source: incomplete workflow inventory permission denial provider API failure stale evidence or reviewer misunderstanding of event and run boundaries
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: one or more execution or authority paths cannot be evaluated but the repository is nevertheless reported as fork-safe
Why This Check Is Required: distinct NOT_CHECKED and ERROR states prevent missing provider facts and partial review coverage from becoming false assurance
Required State: missing workflow inventory inaccessible provider settings ambiguous data flow and failed live checks remain NOT_CHECKED or ERROR
Verification Method: confirm that the review covers every pull-request-related workflow and records unavailable settings failed checks and stale evidence explicitly
Expected Result: only complete current live observations can support PASS while missing or failed observations are NOT_CHECKED or ERROR
Required Evidence: dated workflow inventory with reviewer and target repository; manual verification record containing PASS FAIL NOT_CHECKED or ERROR for every check
Framework Mappings: UNMAPPED — framework review required
